newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-BORUSSIA DORTMUND V JUVENTUS TEAMS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BORUSSIA DORTMUND V JUVENTUS TEAMS.

text.p: Teams for Wednesday's European Cup final between holders Juventus and Borussia Dortmund at the Olympic Stadium:

Juventus: 1-Angelo Peruzzi; 2-Ciro Ferrara, 4-Paolo Montero, 5-Sergio Porrini, 13-Mark Juliano, 7-Angelo Di Livio, 14-Didier Deschamps, 21-Zinedine Zidane, 18-Vladimir Jugovic, 9-Alen Boksic, 15-Christian Vieri

Borussia Dortmund: 1-Stefan Klos; 6-Matthias Sammer, 16-Martin Kree, 15-Juergen Kohler, 7-Stefan Reuter, 19-Paulo Sousa, 14-Paul Lambert, 17-Joerg Heinrich, 10-Andreas Moeller, 9-Stephane Chapuisat, 13-Karlheinz Reidle
